scripts.build: npm run build -w @projectplaner/shared && npm run build -w @projectplaner/api && npm run build -w @projectplaner/mcp && npm run build -w @projectplaner/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @projectplaner/shared" "npm run dev -w @projectplaner/api" "npm run worker -w @projectplaner/api" "npm run dev -w @projectplaner/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @projectplaner/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @projectplaner/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @projectplaner/api && npm run typecheck -w @projectplaner/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @projectplaner/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @projectplaner/api && npm run test -w @projectplaner/mcp && npm run test -w @projectplaner/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @projectplaner/api
